desc: The ambidextrous latches on RISE Ambidextrous Charging Handle facilitate quick and easy charging, even if you’re wearing gloves or have optics mounted on your rifle. As a result, you’ll experience faster and smoother charging on your AR-15. Thanks to the anti-slip grooves on each latch, you can pull the RISE Ambidextrous Charging Handle with confidence each time. It’s the ideal charging handle for both left- and right-handed shooters. Precision machined from 7075 aluminum and a black anodize finish, the RISE Ambidextrous Charging Handle is built for performance and reliability.
